notes.unit-1: Unit 1 is Christian, Freeborn, Putnam, Slottman, Deutsch and Cheney Halls (OSM ways 62200987-style dormitories by Durant Avenue: 62200983, 40413745, 40413752, 62200987, 41746106, 40413757); the pin is their middle. The word rule had picked the Oxford Research Unit greenhouse.
notes.unit-2: Unit 2 is Towle, Griffiths, Ehrman, Davidson, Cunningham and Wada Halls (OSM ways 109192571, 109192574, 109192575, 109192576, 109192581, 109192579); the pin is their middle.
notes.unit-3: Unit 3 is Norton, Spens-Black, Ida Sproul and Priestley Halls (OSM ways 41746358, 41746363, 41746383, 41746395); the pin is their middle.
notes.foothill: Foothill is the La Loma 1-3 and Hillside 4-9 buildings (OSM ways 24024505, 38939695, 38939707, 24907719, 35894521, 473599691, 473599692); the pin is their middle.
notes.clark-kerr: OSM names none of the Clark Kerr Campus buildings; pinned at its 'Clark Kerr Campus' stop on Horseshoe Driveway (node/6563941561), the complex's main drive.
